purpose: Permanent evidence index for videos, interviews, demos and documentary material relevant to EDGE/Loterias AI. Media is treated as discovery evidence unless independently corroborated by operator/provider/regulator or reproducible mathematics.

evidenceGrades.MEDIA_POINTER: Video/demo exists and is relevant, but its claims cannot self-authorize a rule or wager.
evidenceGrades.CORROBORATED_MECHANIC: Media claim is independently corroborated by provider/operator/regulator or mathematically reviewed source.
evidenceGrades.OPERATOR_EXACT: Exact current operator deployment/rules/state verified for the target jurisdiction.
evidenceGrades.EXECUTION_READY: Requires exact current state, stake, rules fingerprint, prospective validation and positive-EV review. No media source can self-promote to this grade.

corroboration.fact: Ocean Magic is an IGT variable-state slot; wild bubbles move one row after each play and favorable bubbles abandoned by a previous player can create player advantage.
Rules explicitly state bubble positions on reels are persistent per bet level.
IGT identifies Ocean Magic and documents the Wild Bubble/Bubble Boost mechanics.
